{{Quote|Vaux, you're picking up our fighter parts in the market.|Hera Syndulla, to Vaux|<ref name="Blood" />}}
'''Vaux''' was a [[human]] who acted as a rebel contact<ref name="Blood" /> in [[4 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Blood Sisters]]" to [[4 BBY]].</ref> While on the [[planet]] [[Garel]], [[Phoenix Cell]] member [[Hera Syndulla]] sent Vaux and a woman on a mission to find [[starfighter]] parts for the [[squadron]] in a market, hidden in crates labeled "[[Ronto]] Meat." Syndulla warned the pair about increased patrols consisting of [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[stormtrooper]]s. With that, Vaux and the woman departed on their mission.<ref name="Blood" />

Vaux wore [[Color|tan]] [[clothing]] and a blue helmet which obscured half of<ref name="Blood" /> his<ref name="Trivia Guide" /> face and had the markings "G6" in [[Aurebesh]]. They had light-colored skin.<ref name="Blood" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vaux first appeared in "[[Blood Sisters]],"<ref name="Blood" /> the eighth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' animation television series<ref name="Rebels">{{SW|url=tv-shows/star-wars-rebels|text=Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> which aired on [[November 8]], [[2015]].<ref name="Blood Sisters">{{WebCite|url=http://affiliate.zap2it.com/tv/star-wars-rebels/EP018796240037?aid=dxd|text=Star Wars Rebels: Blood Sisters|work=Disney XD Official Schedule|archivedate=20160604021106}}</ref> In the episode's script, the character was originally to be named "Jebble" and the crates he was to pick up labeled "[[Wookiee]] Meat," but this was changed during production.<ref name="Trivia Guide" />
